main_text.p: eo exemplari usus fuerit. Domino Cramoisy mitto indicem librorum Græcorum, qvi penes me sunt, qvos tuo arbitratu cum aliis ab ipso editis commutabo: rem totam plenius ex ipsis literis perspicies. Cum Dominis Puteanis velim agas de Vitis Pontificum, qvas paro; & præsertim de Anastasio bibliothecario, cujus exemplar Parisiis extare a-junt, ab edito longe diversum. Reverendissimo P. Sirmendo qvam commendatissima esse cupio studia mea, cui id velim persvadeas, me nomini ipsius esse addictissimum [?]: id qvoqve perqviras, num Anastasii Sinaitæ opera græca Manuscripta meo sumptu atqve ære hic transcripta, Domino Cramoisy tradita fuerint. Nollem enim perire, uti etiam collationes Hoseæ Prophetæ ad antiqvissimum exemplar Barberinæ bibliothecæ à me institutas, qvas P. Philippæo tradendas miseram: plura tempus vetat, tu amantem redama, & rem feliciter gere: sic tibi iter, qvod paras, cæte-

page.notes: An ink blot covers part of "addictissimum" (the "ss" area), so that word is marked [?]. The word at the line end "a-junt" is printed with a hyphen after "a" and is kept as printed. The catchword "raqve" is at the lower right and is not repeated in the text.
